liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Maybe You Know** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Brent struggled about five minutes to find the chords before singing, while the drummers waited for him; Brent skipped the drum solo and did this with only the drummers plus Jose Lorenzo; Jerry came out at the end [1][9][10][13][14]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad** (2 reviews): Jerry went straight into it to rescue things, omitting the drums/space segment; Garcia picks out the riff to this song, ending Brent's Maybe You Know [10][14]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer calls Jerry's Morning Dew after the rescue a great one; The first ten seconds were patched using a source from David Gans [2][10]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-04-21.140223.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 146 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd86-04-21.sbd.jeffm.1857.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 2.79/5 by 62 [4]. Said about its sound: The soundboard has static and a noticeable odd cut, without a blank spot, in this song; the text file doesn't mention it; Listener hears a strange voice-like sound during the Drums/Keys jam and wonders if it was added [15][17]
- **gd1986-04-21.sbd.miller.34765.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 139 min; rated 3.12/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1986-04-21.sbd-pcm.miller.34766.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 145 min; rated 2/5 by 4 [3]

## Around the show

- Brent seemed off all night, singing off-key and playing erratically, which the reviewer blames on being wasted, tired or depressed [9]
- Jerry came out to salvage the second set, then Phil, then Bobby ran out from backstage [11]
- After the show, Brent had to be poured into the back seat of a Sausalito limo [11]
- Reviewer had read about this show in the book Long Strange Trip, and says the rest of the show is solid [12]
- The show was a Rex benefit; Jose Lorenzo joined on drums during Eyes and Drums, and Brent played through drums [1]
- Rex benefit show; Jose Lorenzo joined on drums; Maybe You Know was performed without Jerry and Phil [4]
- Reviewer says any My Brother Esau is a worse version than this Maybe You Know [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-04-21.140223.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Charlie Miller, Jim Wise, Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 (110 degree ORTF)> Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown deck/hardware/software) > hard disk >… [1]
- **gd86-04-21.sbd.jeffm.1857.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Master Cassette> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN [4]
- **gd1986-04-21.sbd.miller.34765.flac16**: taped by Thanks to Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for the Cassettes; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B) D [2]
- **gd1986-04-21.sbd-pcm.miller.34766.flac16**: transferred by David Gans and Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> PCM -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD; Set 2: SBD -> PCM -> Dat [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-04-22 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA. - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-04-22-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca/) [20]
- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-04-22 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA. - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-04-22-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca/) [21]
